review_description: I recently had Western Elec install a solar system with battery storage at my property, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From start to finish, Michael and Tom's professionalism and attention to detail were outstanding.The installation was completed efficiently and on schedule, with minimal disruption. They were courteous, tidy, and clearly skilled at what they do.I was kept informed throughout the process, and any questions I had were answered promptly. I highly recommend them to anyone considering solar and battery solutions – reliable, knowledgeable, and genuinely customer-focused.

Western Elec installed 24 Panels and battery system on my new home.  Michael and Tom were very professional and were also technically astute.The installation was smooth and very neat, with an explanation of what and how was being done.I have no hesitation in recommending both Michael & Tom of Western Elec to anyone needing a system.

Recently, I had a complete solar package installed by Western Elec in Werribee — a 7.92kW solar panel system with a Sungrow Inverter and Sungrow Battery. From my very first contact with Western Elec through to signing the contract, claiming rebates, and the installation itself, the entire process was an absolute pleasure.I can't speak highly enough about the team at Western Elec. They were incredibly professional, always willing to explain things clearly — even when I called multiple times with lots of questions. Th eir patience and politeness stood out, and it made the whole experience stress-free.When installation day came, the crew was efficient and respectful. Once they finished, you wouldn't have even known they’d been there — they left the site spotless, taking every bit of rubbish with them.I also want to give a shout-out to Solar Quotes, who helped guide me through the process. Their YouTube channel and trusted installer list led me to Western Elec, and I'm so glad it did. If you're looking for a solar system, I strongly recommend checking them out — and definitely give Western Elec a call.Thanks again to the whole team — I’m very happy with my new solar setup!

Good price, changed to a higher grade inverter which they offered at minimal upgrade cost, good communication, on time installation, clean well fitted finish, & no complaints.Good communication.This is my second system, already have a still going 5kw system.

Fantastic experience with Western Elec all through the entire process - from the initial call by Michael to follow up after receiving my details from SolarQuotes to the multiple questions I raised, with him patiently answering them, to the quote to another set of multiple questions on the gears used and system design setup being offered, to delivery and installation, the whole experience was fantastic. Can't fault anything, even if I want to nitpick, I can't find anything to nitpick on. That's how good the experience was.The quality of their installation was solid. Will use them again in a heartbeat. I highly highly recommend them if you are reading this and wondering who to use. Go ahead and use them you will be glad you did! Respectful bunch, and polite. Tidied up the premise after they were done, no debris was left behind.And also, punctual! When Michael said they will rock at my property at 7am for the installation, and to my pleasant surprise he turned up exactly at 7am.And thank you to Solar Quotes for referring them to me. Couldn't have asked for a better partner for my battery and solar installation

I found the guys to be a pleasure to deal with from the start, the price was very competitive and the service fantastic!They dealt with all the rebates, supplying more than one quote and made sure we had options that suited our needs.They arrived when they said they would, did what they had to do and cleaned up after themselves.Our initial solar system was fitted and supplied them and we returned as customers to get our batteries installed.Would recommend them!

Great communication from green throughout the process from quote to installation, staff always reply to emails or answer questions over the phone. The installers were great and very helpful. Highly recommended company.
Nice guys, efficient and helpful.Happy with how the installation went.

After getting overquoted and hassled by other solar companies with pushy sales tactics, it was such a relief to deal with a team that was upfront and easy to work with. They gave me a fair, competitive price from the start — no gimmicks — and actually showed up when they said they would. The system they installed is great quality, looks really neat, and everything was done properly. They were always available to answer questions and offer advice, but never pushy. Just genuinely honest and helpful the whole way through. Really happy with the whole experience.

Michael and Tom recently installed a system on my two storey unit. From the initial and prompt contact to the end of the job they were highly professional. Great work ethic, clear and timely communication, positive interactions on site during the quote process and on the install day, competitive quote. The clean up after the job was outstanding. They assisted with every step of the process including solar rebate and grid connection. Exceptional work. I highly recommend their services.

Pleasantly surprised and pleased with the professionalism from Michael and Tom. Quoting process was straight forward and Michael was really accommodating with a range of various configurations and options.The communication process before and during the installation was great. On the day when power off was required, worked around the family needs which was greatly appreciated.The quote process was very simple and no surprises at the end.Quality of their workmanship was great, l have seen a number of installs, and these guys are first class. Everything is concealed as far as possible. My meter box was a bit of mess following additions over many years, they took the time to re-orient and clean the lay-out right up.As part of the install, l also wanted battery back-up to future proof from any electrical outage on the networkAbsolutely no mess when they finished. Inspection, connection process, etc.. all taken care of.You definitely want to give Western Elec the opportunity on your next job.

We decided to upgrade our solar system and add batteries to it for maximum efficiency. We obtained three quotes, but the one from the Western Elec proved to be by far the best, in terms of value and design.The installation process was smooth, with Tom and Michael showing up on time, walking us through the steps of the process and answering to our question in a polite and cordial manner.Our system was installed over a two days period, and the installers kept the property tidy at all times.When the system was ready to run, Tom helped us set up the solar app and organised the inspection of the installation to occur within a few days, so we could start using the system as soon as possible.We were very impressed with the professionalism and the dedication of this wonderful team and we will definitely use them again for any electrical works that we may need in the future.

Dealing with Tom and Michael has been an absolute pleasure. The quote process was very simple. They took my requirements into consideration and provided the assistance I asked for.Being a new build they were flexible in working with the builder's electrician to have all the cabling done internally during the build. They came back post build to install the panels and inverter/smart meter along with the bird netting.They answered all my calls/text and emails promptly and guided me through the connection process even getting in contact with Fronius a couple of times to ensure everything was done right. They were also kind enough to install my inverter cover.Overall it is a very neat install. We couldn't be happier.

After contacting Michael to discuss our requirements in which several options were proposed back to me via email, (we settled on a 10Kw system with batteries) everything went very well from quoting to the site inspection to organising a date for install and( how to operate the system) to the final solar inspection and certification (2 days install and the inspector came after another 2 days), All the paperwork was organised very quickly and smoothly. Michael & Tom were punctual, very polite and they cleaned up at the end of both days. Highly recommended them. The system is currently up and running and working extremely well.

Everything was communicated via email. (no annoying sales phones calls). I was quoted on a few options but went with 6.6KW Jinko panels and Sungro Inverter.Michael and Tom turned up at 7am and worked straight through until they finished the install at around 2pm. Panels look great and they left everything very tidy. Even moved my aerial.After install I was shown how to turn off the inverter (in case of emergency) and they let me know what happens after ie Inspection and grid connection.Had a few questions after install that have been answered via email.Highly recommend them.

The quoting process was very detailed providing a quote for three different sized inverters. The installers were on time and did a great job. Western Elec organised the inspector following installation and organised connection to the grid. Great service and after sales support.

Sales and quoting process was pretty simple with all three providing comparable prices.Installation went seamlessly. Michael and Tom arrived on time, where very polite, tidy and explained everything to me.

Tom (Western Elec) has recently installed an 11kw system on our metal roof in Port Melbourne. His online tools made the whole process really simple. He responded quickly to any questions we had, and managed all the 'paperwork' electronically, ensuring that we received our government rebates quickly. He has done a really professional/neat job installing the panels and inverter. His price was very competitive. He came when he said we would and completed the job in the two days he planned for the job. And he's just a lovely young bloke to boot! What more could you ask!
loved how grounded Micheal was and not chasing. no push to work out how I ticked and push for a sale.well priced too.

Everything went very well. From quote to call out and measure,  requote, All the paperwork was organised very quickly and smoothly.  They were punctual, very polite and everything was cleaned up.  Highly recommended them . The system is working really well.

We were initially unsure if we should use Western Elec as our solar installer, considering they have the least online reviews from the other 2 companies we got the quotes from. A call from Michael erased the uncertainty. Instead we received strong commitments without any sales gimmick, which was very different from the others. The honest consultations and easy communication provided assurance to our choice.On the day of installation, Michael and Tom arrived not only on time, but also acted with professionalism and courtesy. The whole process including rebate application was stress free. Thank you to Michael and Tom.If you are thinking about having them install your solar system, my recommendation is yes. The numbers of online reviews or age of a company is unimportant, the trustworthy and excellent service is what matters.

I used SolarQuotes to get quotes for my daughter and her partner’s house in Werribee, Vic. Had already arranged for solar panels and inverter for another of our children, so knew exactly which panels and inverter we wanted (SolarQuotes is such a great resource).  Of the three quotes, one came back which included the Vic Government interest free loan to reduce the quote, which seemed a bit dodgy (and they were still the most expensive). The cheapest quote came from a large ( ish)  Melbourne firm with mostly good reviews, but some very bad ones. Reading between the lines, I’m guessing the quality of the installation depended on the crew who was assigned to install. The quote coming from Western Elec was the last to come in, and was about $500 more expensive than the cheapest quote. They only had a handful of reviews on Solar Quotes, but all were 5 star.  When I spoke to the co-owner he said that they were a Werribee based business, and it was just them and their partner who did the installation.  I explained that the house had a tiled roof and my daughter didn’t have any spares. No problems, they would swing past to check the roof, and source any if required. Then there was an issue with the local electricity supplier about feeding electricity back into the grid. They sorted that issue as well. They turned up on the agreed day at the agreed time. Did an excellent job on the installation and didn't leave ANY mess.  Would highly recommend.
Promt service and competitive quote.Excellent communication and very timely.I would highly recommend Western Electricity.

I highly recommend Western Elec for any solar installation needs. From initial quote to completing the installation, Michael and Tom were professional, punctual and efficient and I am extremely satisfied with the outcome of their work.In addition installed 2 split system air conditionersThank you, Michael and Tom, for your exceptional service

Tom and Michael were on time the day of installation, they explained what they were going to do and to my surprise and pleasure they were going to do the installation themselves!! The result is a very satisfactory job and now I am in contact with a company that is efficient and competent. I could not recommend Western Elec. more highly.

Great team, Western, ElectricalMichael and Tom come out for a site inspection explain all my options in easy to understand termsI decided to go with a 13.2 kW system On the day the boys were here early had the system fitted within two days promptly and the cleaners Trademan I have seen for a long timeHad a few questions after the systems fitted Michael rang straight back to answer my questions
Very happy with the whole process from start to finish.. both guys take pride and care in their duties and would recommend them to others..

From day one Western Elec had a professional down to earth manner that made the whole process from quote to installation a breeze. They submitted all the Solar administration requirements on my behalf and kept me informed of all the steps in the process with no hassles or drama.The day of the installation was seemingly effortless - they consulted with me on the best position for the inverter and the solar panel arrangement on the roof to ensure we maximising full sunlight and they even added several more panel optimisers in a shaded area free of charge.So if your looking for a hassle free professional solar quote and installation, I highly recommend your contact Western Elec.

Extremely happy with the boys at Western Elec! In my initial stages of gathering solar quotes, I found Michael to be the most professional (with no pushy sales calls). Quote was issued in a very timely manner and follow up emails were attentive and informative.The installation was flawless and it was clear they take great pride in their work. They went above and beyond to hide all cable work and were very conscious to have the panel array perfectly centred. I’ve already recommended Western Elec to family and friends and will personally be using them again in the future.

The Team at Western Elec are incredible - from quotation to installation they ensured that we had the best fit system for all the quirks of our roof.Consistent and clear communication their informed support and attention to detail were fantastic, and rapidly supported me with any questions I had, even post installation.

The team at Western Elec have done a fantastic job with our solar rooftop installation.Tom was knowledgeable and thoughtful during the requested site inspection, answering questions and accommodating requests whilst ensuring our overall goals were still being achieved.Installation was prompt without being rushed and completed by the team within a day without issue. Aesthetically, the system was installed beautifully, with minimum visual disturbance to the building; the inverter was neatly and thoughtfully positioned, with tidy cabling and conduits installation, and the solar panel arrays look great from all visible angles.In the weeks following installation, the system has performed very well to date, consistently generating power above estimations despite being Winter. We can partially attribute this to the team's advice and guidance during the design of our system.First-class service and quality all round, with no hesitations to recommend to others.

I cannot express how happy I am with Tom and Michael. From the get go, an extremely informative site visit and thorough explanations on the whole process.  I did so much due diligence as I wanted a massive system but most importantly, to be executed professionally. Tom and Michael certainly did not disappointment.  I am grateful to have met such a pair of lovely tradies , both A grade and it shows. They work together seamlessly. I highly recommend and future customers can feel free to contact me on my experience and I can assure you that you will be lucky to have them at your premises. They are GOLD!

Extremely happy with our solar installation, it has been up and running for a few months now. Michael was fantastic to deal with from quote to installation. Compared to other installers, I found him to be more thoughtful with the quotes, and genuine with sound knowledge and experience (as he does both the design and installation).High quality service and installation overall - I highly recommend them.

The quoting process was painless.Tom was happy to answer all my concerns promptly via telephone and email.I was asked to submit photos of my meter and my prefered location for the inverter and when I explained my future solar needs i was given options on different size systems to suit.We decided on a 11kw systemTom visited my home to inspect the site so there was no suprises.On installation day the guys were on time and worked very hard to get the job done and the work was very neat with no broken tiles and finished on the day.The electrical inspector is booked in to inspect the job tomorrow!

I have decided to install rooftop solar after ordering my first EV. I'm living in a townhouse with ca. 55sqm of roof - with multiple split system units and satellite dish, the usable space for panels was much lower.I have sourced quotes from 5 installers - Western Elec crew were the only ones who came to do on-site inspection, with the rest relying on satellite images (plus my more detailed plans of the roof, access, etc.).I like to do my own research - side effect being plethora of questions, and design changes. Tom has always been available to answer my email, talk, and to provide updated quote.There were couple of firsts for him as well - for example installation of EV charger that I pre-purchased with the car and use of scissor lift to access the roof.None of the above has been a problem, even removal and disposal of old satellite dish.The installation took place two weeks after signing the contract. The crew were on time, and even the weather (raining on and off) did not phase them. Installation was completed within the day and I cannot be happier with the quality of workmanship and performance of the crew.They were also always happy to respond to any follow-up questions I had.Overall, very pleased with the whole process - from site visit, through installation, to aftercare.Highly recommended.

Really happy with the quality install Western Elec did -Was one of the few who would come out to site to have a look when quoting.The install day went smoothly and everything was left neat and tidy.Grid connection process took a few weeks but not at the fault of Western Elec, the inspection check was quickly organised and we had a delay with Momentum energy but once up and running weve been very happy.

Western Elec gave us nicely detailed quotes, they preemptively sent through several options at various Kw sizes without spending too much time with us trying to discuss why to move to a larger system like other more pushy retailers. Instead , their quotes included designs and fully detailed quotes and thinking behind why to choose various options. We really appreciated that.Western Elec quoted amongst the best priced systems. We opted for a larger 13Kw system than the original 6Kw we had originally contemplated based upon the reasonable pricing.The install team of 2 were not only on time, but worked fast and did an amazing job. Maybe this is an industry of tough workers, but I have personally never seen a team work so hard across both extreme physical and technical areas and accomplish so much in one day.The install is very neat and the conduit-lines are all sealed very nicely, so the inverter and panels really don't adversely affect the look of the property.We have been generating more power than we need with this system, and thanks to the Western Elec team for explaining how to manage and read the GoodWe HomeKit monitor, we can see that on most days we export a consistent 5Kw to the grid (the max we are allowed) while covering all of our own power consumption needs. Really comforting to be able to see all this data live.I would recommend setting up a seperate or guest WiFi prior to a GoodWe inverter installation, having your wifi network setup ready for your installer will save you time and give the team an easier/faster setup for you.While the team are always busy working on a roof somewhere, they always took my calls.I'd recommend Western Elec if you are looking to install Solar on your property.

Western Elec provided the most thorough, thought out and competitive quote for installation of my solar.Once booked in, the process was explained and the team was always on time.The installation was completed quickly and neatly and all my questions and concerns were answered well.After the install I had further question and they were addressed quickly, even coming to my house to upgrade the monitoring system.I would highly recommend Western Elec to anyone.
